senses.gloss:
चुञ्चु चुञ्चु, उस्, उस्, उ (considered as an
affix at the end of certain comp.), known, cele-
brated, renowned [cf. अक्षर-चुञ्चु, चार-च्˚,
[]
चञ्चु, चण]; (उस्), m. the musk-rat or shrew; a
mixed caste, born of a Brāhman father by a Vaideha
female, whose business is hunting; N. of a man.

चुञ्चुमायन चुञ्चुमायन, अम्, n. irritation
or itching (of a wound).

चुञ्चुरी चुञ्चुरी, f. a game, a kind of hazard
played with tamarind seeds instead of dice; also
चुञ्चुलि and चुञ्चुली.

चुञ्चुल चुञ्चुल, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्),
m. pl. his descendants.
